text: Business administration is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates economics, management, law and information technology, aiming to cultivate compound talents with modern management concepts, business analysis capabilities and practical operation skills. This major takes enterprise operation and management as its core, studying how to optimize resource allocation through functions such as planning, organizing, leading and controlling, and enhance organizational efficiency and competitiveness. It covers multiple fields including strategic planning, marketing, human resources, financial management and operation management.
